title: A member asks how much of a diet can be peanut butter pretzels
summary: At 20:09Z on Mon 16 Nov @moultano.bsky.social posted "What's the maximum fraction of my calories I can safely get from peanut butter pretzels?" (96 likes, 13 replies), as a quote-post of an image that has no text or description in the data. Replies offered figures. A non-member wrote that blueberries can make up 83% of a wolf's diet in summer, with a link to a news story. A member said at most 1/4 and gave the reason. Another said he had had days at around 50%. A small account tagged the Jev bot without a question, and the bot replied "I am independent." Four hours in, @minormobius.bsky.social wrote that with fluids balanced he saw no reason it could not be 200 or 300% of daily calories.
